tests.name: the on-demand probe establishes the verdict
the cache lives under the git COMMON dir, not the worktree's own
no per-worktree copy of the cache — they share exactly one
an on-demand caller does not advance the watermark — one writer
and holds exactly the lines a consumer needs — one per unlanded commit
which is the commit itself, not a record about it
after a land the verdict is settled
and the verdict is established, not merely absent
and the file is EMPTY — its presence is the whole verdict
the settled marker survives an append-only base move
the old tip's answer is untouched — it is still true of that OID
the amended tip has no cached answer — the miss IS the invalidation
and the on-demand probe computes it afresh
storing what it computed under the new tip
no hook branch reaps worktrees any more
and the removal says where reaping lives instead
the cheap SHA-containment test it needed is gone
and so is the landed-SHA credit that propped it up
condition 4 reads the shared cache, computing on a miss
while the filesystem checks stay live and uncached
runGit takes a context as its first parameter
there is no context-free door beside it
a cancelled context is the second benign death, beside SIGINT
the ◆ path is cache-only, by the mode it passes
the on-demand path computes on a miss
and the cache-only branch returns before the resolver is reached
the cache marshals nothing — there is no record type
an unsettled entry is written temp-then-rename
~ is tested FIRST in the column
and the legend documents it like the other states
the job is wired by blank import, like the other three
and is fired by the existing liveview trigger — nothing new wired
